spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Leanne Whitlock. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time because your mobile app was down. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that happened, Leanne. I can understand how frustrating that must be. Before I look at anything on your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s all verified, thanks. I’m sure we’ll get that late payment charge refunded for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Well, the electricity company charged me £25 because the app wouldn’t let me make the payment on the 18th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left with that charge. Which bill was it, and how much was the payment?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: BrightSpark Energy, £86.40. I paid it the next morning when the app worked again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right, I can see that payment on the 19th. I’ll put a note on your account about the app being unavailable and the charge you’ve incurred.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That doesn’t really make up for the trouble. I shouldn’t have been charged because your app was down.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I do understand why you’re unhappy, Leanne, and I’m sorry for the inconvenience. I’ll note what you’ve told me here.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks. That will explain the outcome and what, if anything, can be done about the charge.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise, I’ve noted the app outage and the £25 charge, and you’ll get that full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
